roads.name: Kashagawigamog Lake Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 21 curves in 5.6 miles.
The 4 miles at the east end are tamer.
From 1,043 to 1,172 ft, with 709 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
Water alongside for stretches.
7 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 80 km/h limit its curves ask for about 0.21 g. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this takes Ontario's 80 km/h.
